'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Greg Shaw LS Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)|OVS15-30-Tatooine_Lars_Moisture_Farm-remaster.webp|label=Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Garden State
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
